The Commvault REST API provides programmatic access to Commvault data protection and management operations, including clients, agents, subclients, backup jobs, restore jobs, storage policies, schedules, and reporting. This API uses XML or JSON request and response bodies and supports token-based authentication via login credentials or SAML-based SSO.
